title: Judges Bible Quiz - Chapter 17
description: Ten questions on Judges 17: Micah of Ephraim, with the stolen silver, the household gods and the Levite from Bethlehem Judah who became his priest.

questions.text: Where did the man named Micah live?
questions.explanation: There was a man of the hill country of Ephraim, whose name was Micah.

answers.text: In the hill country of Ephraim

questions.text: How many pieces of silver had been taken from Micah's mother?
questions.explanation: Micah said, "The eleven hundred pieces of silver that were taken from you... behold, the silver is with me. I took it."

questions.text: What did Micah's mother say when he admitted taking the silver?
questions.explanation: His mother said, "May Yahweh bless my son!"

answers.text: "Give it back, or the curse will stay on you!"
"Go and offer a sacrifice for your sin."

questions.text: How many pieces of silver did his mother give to the silversmith?
questions.explanation: His mother took two hundred pieces of silver and gave them to a silversmith, who made a carved image and a molten image.

questions.text: Besides a house of gods, what did Micah make?
questions.explanation: Micah had a house of gods, and he made an ephod, and teraphim.

answers.text: A golden calf and an altar

questions.text: Whom did Micah first consecrate to be his priest?
questions.explanation: Micah consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.

questions.text: According to the text, what did everyone do in those days when there was no king in Israel?
questions.explanation: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did that which was right in his own eyes.

answers.text: Whatever the elders of the city decided
That which was right in his own eyes

questions.text: Where did the young Levite come from?
questions.explanation: There was a young man out of Bethlehem Judah, of the family of Judah, who was a Levite.

questions.text: What did Micah offer to pay the Levite each year besides clothing and food?
questions.explanation: Micah said, "I will give you ten pieces of silver per year, a suit of clothing, and your food."

questions.text: Why did Micah say he now knew Yahweh would do good to him?
questions.explanation: Micah said, "Now I know that Yahweh will do good to me, since I have a Levite as my priest."

answers.text: Because his silver had been returned
Because his mother had blessed him
Because he had built a house of gods
Because he had a Levite as his priest
